, starring and , is a Hindi supernatural horror comedy that mixes Indian mythology, family drama, small-town humour and the mystery of a possible daayan. Directed by and produced by Aanand L Rai and Himanshu Sharma, the film asks an intriguing question: what happens when a seemingly perfect new bride becomes the centre of suspicion in her own family?
In this episode of Firstpost Presents: First Cut, Dabeet Singh reviews and analyses Nayyi Navelli, exploring the story, performances, comedy, horror, mythology, direction and everything in between.
